config.backup.create_desc: Creates an .ago archive (ZIP) with config, prompts, data and skills. When a password is set, all vault secrets (API keys, tokens) are also securely included — ideal for migrating to a new instance (e.g. with systemd-injected master key).
config.backup.import_warning: Important: Import does not change anything immediately. The backup is staged and applied at the next AuraGo restart (a restart is required); then config, prompts, data and skills are replaced.
config.backup.no_password_warning: Without a password, no API keys, login password or tokens will be backed up. Always set a password for a complete migration.
config.backup.password_hint: Archive will be encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Leave empty for plain ZIP.
config.backup.password_required: Encrypted backup — please enter the password.
config.backup.vault_included_hint: 🔐 Vault secrets (API keys, login password, tokens) will be included.
config.backup.confirm_import_message: Restoring "{name}" will replace this instance's configuration, prompts, data and skills, and the stored API keys, tokens and login password if the archive contains vault secrets. Nothing changes until AuraGo is restarted; the backup, including those secrets, takes effect at the next start. This cannot be undone.
config.backup.restore_pending_note: The restore is pending and takes effect after AuraGo restarts.
config.backup.error_http: The server sent an unexpected response (HTTP {status}).
config.backup.restore_pending_since: A restore has been pending since {time} — restart AuraGo to apply it.
config.backup.last_restore_rolled_back: Last restore from {time} was rolled back — nothing was changed.
config.backup.last_restore_failed: Last restore from {time} failed — nothing was applied.
config.backup.discard_confirm_message: The staged backup will not be applied at the next start and the staged files are deleted. The current configuration stays as it is.
config.backup.discard_nothing: There was no pending restore to discard.
config.backup.discard_unsupported: This server version cannot discard a pending restore.
config.backup.include_vectordb_help: Adds the vector database (memory embeddings). Saves recomputing after a restore, but often makes the archive very large.
config.backup.include_workdir_help: Adds the agent's working directory with all files in it. This can take a lot of space.
config.backup.select_file_help: A backup created earlier, with the .ago extension. Importing overwrites existing data.
config.backup.import_password_help: Only needed if the backup was encrypted. It must be the same password as when it was created.
